pages.title: Big Cannons
pages.text: Create Big Cannons adds artillery built as contraptions: cast or built-up barrels, breeches, mounts, loaders and munitions. Ponder explains each step; this page only covers what connects to the rest of the pack.

pages.title: Cannon Mount
pages.text: The rotating base that aims a cannon. Cannons are assembled onto it as a contraption.

pages.title: Cannon Loader
pages.text: A contraption part that pushes charges and shells in. Cartridges and powder charges set range, shells set effect.

pages.title: Basin Foundry Lid
pages.text: Melts bronze, cast iron and nethersteel in a heated basin for casting cannon parts.
TFMG ties in: its Casting Basin casts Big Cannons bronze, cast iron and nethersteel. Its vat with graphite electrodes turns netherite scrap and molten steel into nethersteel.

pages.title: Steel and bronze
pages.text: Big Cannons' own steel recipes (mixing iron and coal, compacting molten steel) now give [#](2E5AAC)[TFMG steel](entry://industry/tfmg_steel)[#](), and bronze comes from Alloyed's mixer recipe (Big Cannons' cheaper bronze mixes are off). Old Big Cannons steel and bronze convert in a crafting grid. See [#](2E5AAC)[Shared Metals](entry://materials/shared_metals)[#]().
Cannons are built from contraptions: [#](2E5AAC)[Contraptions](entry://create_basics/contraptions)[#](), so you can mount them on moving builds. Handle with care: shells destroy blocks.
